title: Love in the time of Alzheimer: Gabriel García Márquez’s pact with solitude
title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病时代的爱情：加西亚·马尔克斯与孤独的契约
abstract: A.J. Lees explores how Gabriel García Márquez’s Love in the Time of Cholera challenges political and social perceptions of older people as frail and lacking in vitality, while also critiquing profit-driven medicine and the tendency to view ageing, including benign forgetfulness, as a pathological state.
abstract_zh: A.J. Lees探讨了加西亚·马尔克斯的《霍乱时期的爱情》如何挑战社会对老年人体弱无力的看法，同时批判以利润为导向的医学，以及将包括良性健忘在内的老龄化视为病理状态的倾向。
